question: How can a participant react on the shared expense assignment?

sections.beforeHtml: A participant reacts on assigned shared expenses directly in the Trip shared expenses list. The reaction controls appear only when the current participant is the assigned person for that row.
items: Open Dashboard > Trip Shared > Expenses for the selected trip.
Find a row assigned to you. Plantour shows Accepted and Rejected checkboxes only on rows you are allowed to react to.
Click Accepted if you agree to take responsibility for that shared expense. Plantour then creates a corresponding personal trip expense for you.
Click Rejected if you do not want to take responsibility for that shared expense. Plantour marks the assignment as rejected.
If you uncheck Accepted, Plantour removes the personal accepted expense that was created for you.
If you reject an expense that you had already accepted, Plantour clears the accepted link and removes the personal accepted expense from your trip expenses.
Plantour notifies the admin when you accept or reject the assignment.
sections.afterHtml: Accepting is the bridge from the shared-cost page to your own personal expense list. After acceptance, continue with What can a participant do after accepting the expense assignment?.
